name: 星辰影院·AI漫剧
desc: 星辰影院 AI漫剧 正经源

js.home: const cate=env.get("category");const page=env.get("page");const p=Number(page||1);const base=env.baseUrl;const isHome=cate=="/"||!cate;const listUrl=p<=1?(base+"/tv/47.html"):(base+"/tv/47/page/"+p+".html");const html=await(0,utils_1.req)(listUrl);const $=utils_1.kitty.load(html);const items=[];$("a").each(function(){const $a=$(this);const href=$a.attr("href")||"";const m=href.match(/^\/video\/(\d+)\.html$/);if(m){const title=$a.attr("title")||$a.text().trim();if(title&&items.length<40){const id=m[1];const img=$a.find("img").first();const cover=img.attr("data-original")||img.attr("data-src")||img.attr("src")||"";if(!items.some(x=>x.id==="/video/"+id+"/"))items.push({id:"/video/"+id+"/",title,cover,remark:"AI漫剧"})}}});if(isHome){return{type:"complex",data:[{type:"card",title:"AI漫剧",videos:items}]}}return items;
js.detail: let id=env.get("movieId");if(!id)return{};const m=String(id).match(/(\d+)/);if(m)id=m[1];const html=await(0,utils_1.req)(env.baseUrl+"/video/"+id+".html");const $=utils_1.kitty.load(html);let desc="";const dm=$("meta[name=description]").attr("content")||"";desc=dm.replace(/^《[^》]*》免费高清版[^AI]*AI漫剧动漫,.*?就在星辰影院[^.]*\./,"").replace(/^.*?免费播放完整版/,"").trim();let cover=$("img").map(function(){const src=$(this).attr("src")||"";if(src.includes("uploads")||src.includes("vod")||src.includes("cover"))return src;return null}).get().find(x=>x)||"";let title=$("h1").text().trim().replace(/^(漫剧|动漫|短剧)?《/,"").replace(/》.*$/,"");if(!title){const tm=$("meta[property=og:title]").attr("content")||"";title=tm.replace(/^(漫剧|动漫)/,"")}const eps=[];$("a").each(function(){const $a=$(this);const href=$a.attr("href")||"";const em=href.match(/^\/play\/(\d+)\/(\d+)\/(\d+)\.html$/);if(em&&em[1]===String(id)){const text=$a.text().trim();if(text)eps.push({text,id:env.baseUrl+"/play/"+em[1]+"/"+em[2]+"/"+em[3]+".html"})}});return{id:"/video/"+id+"/",title,cover,desc,remark:"AI漫剧",playlist:[{title:"全集",videos:eps}]};
js.search: const wd=env.get("keyword");if(!wd)return[];const html=await(0,utils_1.req)(env.baseUrl+"/search.php?keyword="+encodeURIComponent(wd));const $=utils_1.kitty.load(html);const items=[];$("a").each(function(){const $a=$(this);const href=$a.attr("href")||"";const m=href.match(/^\/video\/(\d+)\.html$/);if(m){const title=$a.attr("title")||$a.text().trim();if(title&&items.length<20){const id=m[1];const img=$a.find("img").first();const cover=img.attr("data-original")||img.attr("data-src")||img.attr("src")||"";if(!items.some(x=>x.id==="/video/"+id+"/"))items.push({id:"/video/"+id+"/",title,cover,remark:""})}}});return items;
